transport_specific.description: Transport-specific header byte in hexadecimal (e.g., '0x00' for Ethernet).

log_level.description: Global logging verbosity (0=debug to 7=emerg). Lower numbers = more verbose.

domain_number.description: PTP domain number (0–127). Must match between master and slave devices.

clock_identity.description: 16-character hexadecimal clock identity. If omitted, auto-derived from MAC.

slave_only.description: Run in slave-only mode (no clock selection, never master).

interface_name.description: Primary network interface to use for PTP (required if no `interfaces` list).

announce_interval.description: Interval between ANNOUNCE messages in seconds (default 0 = standard 2^0 = 1s).

sync_interval.description: Interval between SYNC messages in seconds (default 0 = standard 2^0 = 1s).

delay_req_interval.description: Interval between delay request messages in seconds (default 0 = standard 2^0 = 1s).

path_delay_threshold.description: Path delay asymmetry threshold in nanoseconds (0 = disabled).

priority1.description: Clock priority 1 (0–255); used in best master clock algorithm. Lower = higher priority.

priority2.description: Clock priority 2 (0–255); used if priority1 values tie. Lower = higher priority.

hw_timestamping.description: Enable hardware timestamping (recommended for sub-μs accuracy).

use_kernel_timestamps.description: Use kernel timestamps instead of userspace timestamps (if supported).

interfaces.description: List of additional interfaces to configure (overrides global defaults per interface).

log_level.description: Per-interface log level (if omitted, falls back to global `log_level`).

delay_req_interval.description: Per-interface delay request interval in seconds (falls back to global if omitted).

qos_enabled.description: Enable optional QoS/DSCP configuration for PTP packets.

ptp_dst_dscp.description: DSCP value (0–63) for PTP packet prioritization (e.g., 46 = EF class).
